subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Expressing likes, dislikes and preferences: Activity 4, class survey and discussion
outcomes: Express likes and dislikes using different phrases
Carry out a class survey and report the results

tf.s: 'I'm not very keen on eating out' expresses a dislike.
tf.why: Not keen on means you do not like it much.

tf.s: 'What do you think about...?' is a way to ask for someone's opinion.
tf.why: It invites the other person to share their view.

tf.s: 'In my view...' is used to give an opinion.
In a survey, you interview people and record their answers.
tf.why: A survey collects answers from a group.

tf.s: 'Three of the five students prefer malls' reports a survey result.
tf.why: It tells us what the group said.

tf.s: 'I'd rather shop in a souq than in a mall' expresses a dislike of souqs.
tf.why: It shows a preference for souqs.

tf.s: Closed questions usually give reasons and opinions.
tf.why: Open questions give reasons; closed questions give quick facts.

tf.s: 'Personally speaking...' is a phrase to give your own opinion.
tf.why: It shows you are talking about yourself.

tf.s: 'How about you?' is used to end a conversation.
tf.why: It asks for the other person's opinion.

tf.s: In Activity 4, each student writes five likes and five dislikes.
tf.why: Then they share them in pairs.

boxes.q: Which phrase asks for an opinion?
boxes.why: It invites someone to give their view.

o: I really like the atmosphere in the mall.
I'm not very keen on eating out.
I'm not very keen on eating out.

boxes.why: A survey collects answers from a group.

boxes.q: How many group members do you interview?
boxes.why: Groups of five, so you interview four others.

boxes.q: Complete: I'd ___ shop in a souq than in a mall.

o: Three of the five students prefer malls.
boxes.why: It reports what the group said.

mcq.q: Which phrase is used to ask for someone's opinion?
mcq.why: It is a question about another person's feelings.

mcq.q: Which phrase is used to give your opinion?
What do you do in the class survey?
o: interview group members and record their answers
mcq.why: A survey collects and records answers.

mcq.q: Where can you find helpful phrases for writing about the results?
Write a dislike: 'I'm not very ______ on eating out.'
In your group, 3 out of 5 students prefer malls. Which sentence reports this correctly?
o: Three of the five students prefer shopping in malls.
Five of the three students prefer malls.

mcq.q: You want your friend's opinion after giving yours. What do you say?
mcq.why: It invites your friend to share.

mcq.q: Why does a survey need both open and closed questions?
o: Closed questions give quick facts; open questions give reasons and opinions
Open questions are only for teachers
mcq.why: Using both gives a full picture.

o: Why do you prefer the souq?
mcq.why: 'Why' needs a reason, not just yes or no.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses a variety of language well in a discussion?
o: In my view, malls are convenient, but how about you?
I like. I like. I like.
mcq.why: It gives an opinion and asks for another.
